description: Unit tests for the ReportingService component in Chromium, testing report queuing, URL sanitization, header processing, store interactions, and behavior with network isolation key features.

classes.name: ReportingServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test fixture for testing ReportingService behavior with different configurations.

methods.name: QueueReport
methods.description: Test queuing a report and verifying its properties.

methods.name: QueueReportSanitizeUrl
methods.description: Test URL sanitization when queuing reports.

methods.name: DontQueueReportInvalidUrl
methods.description: Ensure invalid URLs are rejected and not queued.

methods.name: QueueReportNetworkIsolationKeyDisabled
methods.description: Test report queuing behavior when network isolation key feature is disabled.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeader
methods.description: Test processing of report to header JSON and endpoint creation.

methods.name: ProcessReportingEndpointsHeader
methods.description: Test setting reporting endpoints from header and their association with sources.

methods.name: ProcessReportingEndpointsHeaderNetworkIsolationKeyDisabled
methods.description: Test endpoint processing with network isolation key feature disabled.

methods.name: SendReportsAndRemoveSource
methods.description: Test sending reports and removing source, verifying report statuses.

methods.name: SendReportsAndRemoveSourceWithPendingReports
methods.description: Test behavior when removing source with pending reports.

methods.name: ProcessReportingEndpointsHeaderPathAbsolute
methods.description: Test processing of absolute path URLs in headers.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeaderPathAbsolute
methods.description: Test report to header with absolute path URL.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeader_TooLong
methods.description: Test rejection of overly long header.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeader_TooDeep
methods.description: Test rejection of overly deep JSON structure in header.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeaderNetworkIsolationKeyDisabled
methods.description: Test report to header processing with network isolation key feature disabled.

methods.name: WriteToStore
methods.description: Test that store commands are issued correctly during report processing and data removal.

methods.name: WaitUntilLoadFinishesBeforeWritingToStore
methods.description: Test that store writes wait for initial load to complete.
